comflor_46.name: ComFlor® 46
comflor_46.source: Tata Steel / Building Systems UK ComFlor® range overview & technical manual
comflor_46.notes: Shallow over-beam deck; 900 mm cover, 225 mm pitch. wr_mm ≈ average trough for AISC Rg/Rp.

comflor_51_plus.name: ComFlor® 51+
comflor_51_plus.source: Tata Steel / Building Systems UK ComFlor® range overview & technical manual
comflor_51_plus.notes: Re-entrant profile. Default orientation perpendicular to beam; parallel also common — override in UI. wr_mm ≈ opening/average for Rg/Rp.

comflor_60.name: ComFlor® 60
comflor_60.source: Tata Steel / Building Systems UK ComFlor® range overview & technical manual
comflor_60.notes: Trapezoidal; valley≈120 mm / crown≈180 mm → wr_mm avg 150. Typical over-beam orientation: perpendicular.

comflor_60_closed.name: ComFlor® 60 closed ends
comflor_60_closed.source: Tata Steel / Building Systems UK ComFlor® range overview & technical manual
comflor_60_closed.notes: Same geometry as ComFlor 60 with closed ends option.

comflor_80.name: ComFlor® 80
comflor_80.source: Tata Steel / Building Systems UK ComFlor® range overview & technical manual
comflor_80.notes: Deeper trapezoidal over-beam deck; 300 mm pitch.

comflor_80_closed.name: ComFlor® 80 closed ends
comflor_80_closed.source: Tata Steel / Building Systems UK ComFlor® range overview & technical manual
comflor_80_closed.notes: Same geometry as ComFlor 80 with closed ends option.

comflor_100.name: ComFlor® 100
comflor_100.source: Tata Steel / Building Systems UK ComFlor® range overview & technical manual
comflor_100.notes: Deep trapezoidal; 700 mm cover, 233 mm pitch. wr_mm approximate average trough.

comflor_210.name: ComFlor® 210
comflor_210.source: Tata Steel / Building Systems UK ComFlor® range overview & technical manual
comflor_210.notes: Deep deck (long-span / integrated beams). wr_mm approximate average trough.

comflor_225.name: ComFlor® 225
comflor_225.source: Tata Steel / Building Systems UK ComFlor® range overview & technical manual
comflor_225.notes: Deepest ComFlor profile. wr_mm approximate average trough.
